Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

0- General —This standard shall be read in conjuction with IS: 9437 (Part I) - 1980 'Specification for 
fixed precision resistors: Part I General requirements and methods of tests'.

Fig. 1 and Table 1.

2. Ratings— Ratings shall be as specified in Table 1. 

Note — For ratings at temperature other than 70°C, reference should be made to the derating curve shown in 4.

a) Selection tolerance 

b) Stability class 

c) Temperature coefficient 

d) Vibration 

e) Shock 

f) Acceleration 

g) Bump 

h) Maximum surface temperature 
j) Climatic category

5. Marking — See 7 of IS: 9437 (Part I) - 1980. 

6. Material, Construction and Workmanship — See 5 of IS: 9437 (Part I) - 1980. 

7. Classification of Tests — See 8.1 of IS: 9437 (Part I) - 1980. 

7.1 General Conditions for Tests— See 8.2 of IS: 9437 (Part I) - 1980. The same measuring set shall 
be used for any one test but not necessarily for all the tests. 

7.1.1 The test schedule and the requirements shall be in accordance with Table 2.
